title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit log enrichment
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports KMS region pinning and richer audit log fields. No customer-facing API changes. Admins must migrate relevant policies using the provided migration tool. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for rollout notes.
description: Motivation: customers operating under strict data residency and KMS requirements asked for enforcement of regional KMS constraints at the RBAC policy layer and more actionable audit logs. This PR extends RBAC v2 policies with 'kms_region' constraints, enforces them during policy evaluation, adds audit-log enrichment (kms_key_id, kms_region, masked_principal_id), and provides a small migration helper to update existing policies. Changes are split: schema additions, evaluator enforcement, KMS client region validation, audit enrichment, migration CLI, tests and docs. Checklist: [x] Add policy schema field 'kms_region' and validation; [x] Enforce region pinning in policy evaluator; [x] Surface kms region/key in audit events (masked principal); [x] Add migration script and safety checks; [x] Add unit + integration tests; [x] Docs and release notes. Impact: Policy authors can now specify allowed KMS regions per action/resource. Requests that target KMS keys in disallowed regions will be denied early with a clear audit trail. Backwards compatibility: policies without kms_region continue to behave as before. Rollout plan: feature-flagged for three releases, enable logging at INFO for 72h in staging, then flip to enforce in prod. Related: ENG-4921, SEC-217, SUP-834.

review_comments: Evan Liu: Please add an early-deny code path to avoid unnecessary KMS calls when region mismatch is detected. Author: Added evaluator short-circuit and new unit test covering short-circuit behavior.

Marta Gonzalez: Audit event size growth is a concern for high-throughput teams. Can we mask the full key material and keep only key_id and region? Author: We persist only kms_key_id and region; principal is masked with deterministic hash. Updated audit serializer.

Samir Kapoor: Migration could be destructive if policies are authored vaguely. Suggest a dry-run mode and a linear redirector to notify policy owners. Author: Added --dry-run flag and summary output; CLI now writes a migration_preview.json for owners to review.
Evan Liu: Integration tests flaked once in CI due to eventual consistency in kms list-keys. Author: Tightened retry/backoff and added idempotent cleanup in test fixtures; CI stable on rerun.
merge_details: Merged via squash by Marta Gonzalez on 2026-02-25. Squash commit: 'rbac(v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit enrichment - closes ENG-4921, SEC-217'. Release note included. Backout plan: revert to previous policy evaluator and disable enforcement flag; migration changes are non-destructive when dry-run used.
migration_notes: The migration CLI will annotate existing RBAC v2 policies with an explicit 'kms_region' key where a mapping is inferable from policy scope. Operators should run with --dry-run to review suggested annotations. The tool will not modify policies if ambiguity is detected; manual review required. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for examples and rollback steps.
operational_playbook: Feature gated: start with feature flag 'rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce' off. Enable audit enrichment first in staging for 72h, review logs, then enable enforcement in staging with verbose logging. After 2 successful staging cycles, enable in canary prod (subset of tenants) for 24h before global enforcement. If a mature spike of denials is observed, toggle enforcement off and investigate. Incident owner: security-oncall.
